theorem DoubleApexOffSurplusSharedRadiusPair

**Named residual — Route-A double-apex off-surplus shared-radius pair
(2026-07-05).**  The producer attack
(`docs/u-lane/97-u1-2-sharedchord-producer-PROVE-verdict-2026-07-05.md`, option
(b)) reduced the retired arbitrary-centre producer
`twoLargeCaps_sharedChord_sameSide` gap-free to THIS single pure-metric residual:
from the full two-large-cap leaf hypotheses, produce two distinct carrier points
`x, w'` off the surplus cap that are co-radial from BOTH opposite Moser apices
`D.packet.oppApex1`, `D.packet.oppApex2`.

The packet is now the CP-built `leafSurplusPacket` from `(MT, hCirc, CP, i, hM,
hsurplus)`, so the `CP.capAt i > 4` witness and the second-cap `≥ 5` bridge
(`exists_secondLargeCap_of_noM44`) apply to THIS packet's caps.  Downstream is
fully PROVEN (core axioms only): such a pair fires
`U2NonSurplusSqueeze.oppCap2_escape_gen` directly (the off-surplus membership
supplies the same-side sign via
`signedArea2_mul_pos_of_not_mem_surplusCap_gen`, and the two-circle reflection
kernel then contradicts it), so the leaf closes.  The retired producer's
arbitrary-centre existential and the `sharedChord_sameSide_false` certificate
were redundant wrappers around this apex-anchored statement and were dropped.

Open content: does `(≥5,≥5,4)` + center-`K4` + critical shell FORCE the pair?
The conclusion is unsatisfiable over ℝ² (the reflection kernel), so proving it
means deriving the leaf contradiction — the counting/metric-closure question of
whether the two `≥5` caps overflow the apex exact-radius classes into a forced
double-apex coincidence.  Attack surface: the PROVEN U2 squeeze scaffold
(`oppApex1_exactRadiusClass_cover`, `fourClass_of_cover`,
`oppApex{1,2}_interior_card_eq_two_of_isM44`), transferred from the M44 regime to
`hNoM44`, plus the `CP.capAt`-vs-`D.packet` cap linkage.

theorem u2_sharedBase_family_contradiction {A : Finset ℝ²}

**Shared-base family contradiction** (`U2a2-1b4c2e2d3f`).  In the shared-base
normal form, the exact `v₁`-cap class and the selected `s`-class are distinct
circles (`v₁ ≠ s`) sharing the base chord `e₁`–`e₂`; a strict witness `w` common
to both classes and lying off the chord is impossible.

Discharged by building the packet via `u2BaseChordWitnessPacket_of_sharedBase`
and applying the proven two-circle kernel `u2BaseChordWitnessPacket_contradiction`.

Unlike `U2WitnessCoreProduces` (which is vacuous — it assumes the impossible
packet outright), this lemma is **non-vacuous**: it consumes only configuration
facts.  Its single open geometric input is the witness count
`hw_exact` ∧ `hw_sel` (prose `d3f1b`, gap **G3**); `hw_off` is the off-chord
orientation and the rest is mechanical.

theorem source_pushout_right {m : ℕ} {A : Finset ℝ²} {L : CGN.OrderedCap m}

**`U1k-b1a`, right orientation — source-side pushout.**  For a same-cap
incompatible edge spending the right endpoint (`EndpointUsed(x,p)=E_right`), with the
source `x` strictly left of the right endpoint (`hx_lt`), the center `p` not the
right endpoint (`hp_ne`, the `U1k-b1b` exclusion), and `p ≠ x` (`hpx_ne`), the
center lies strictly inside the spent-side interval:
`p ∈ RankInterval(x, E_right) = Ioo x E_right`.  The wrong-side placement
`p < x` is excluded by `samecap_wrongSide_right_contradiction`.

## Source-side pushout (`U1k-b1a`, prose draft ≈9886–9932)

For a same-cap incompatible edge `x → p`, the center `p` lies **strictly inside** the
spent-side rank interval rather than on its endpoint:

```text
EndpointUsed(x,p) = E_right  ⟹  x < p < E_right     (p ∈ Ioo x lastIndex)
EndpointUsed(x,p) = E_left   ⟹  E_left < p < x       (p ∈ Ioo firstIndex x)
```

The prose proves this by excluding the two finite-order alternatives:

* the **wrong-side placement** (`U1k-b1a1`) — discharged this session as the
  `★`-bypass `samecap_wrongSide_{right,left}_contradiction`
  (`U1kWrongSideDischarge.lean`, `U1k-b1a1R` via `CGN6c`);
* the **endpoint equality** (`U1k-b1b`) — here a hypothesis `p ≠ E_side` (the
  center is not the spent endpoint; `p` is a strict interior cap vertex).

Given those two exclusions, finite-order trichotomy places `p` strictly inside
the spent-side interval.  So the pushout is an *assembly* on top of the already
proven wrong-side discharge — no new geometry.

theorem u2WitnessCoreProduces_contradiction {A : Finset ℝ²}

The named geometric core is impossible: a `U2BaseChordWitnessPacket` cannot
exist (two distinct circles through two distinct points have no third common
point off their chord), so any production of one is contradictory.

This is the *proven* half of the interface — it routes through the genuine
two-circle kernel `u2BaseChordWitnessPacket_contradiction`.  The point of
isolating it is to make explicit that the only thing standing between the
finite classifier and `False` is the (open) *production* asserted by
`U2WitnessCoreProduces`.
